message:
Goal: rework the Northside Physio prototype from Dr Shah's five iPad notes, then give you a link to click through.

**Found:**
- Prototype: `proto-clinic/index.html`, four screens (Today, Clients, Invoices, Settings), sample data only.
- Notes: `feedback-from-dr-shah.txt`, five notes, five changes. The result lands in that same file.
- It is for Dr Shah's next click-through, on an iPad.
- Checked: browser for screenshots found, Node 25 found.
- Nothing is committed or published. You get a local link only.

**Track:** full. There is no reference to copy, so quick and full are the same.

Still open after reading your files: what the new-appointment form holds, how "running late" shows, and which font.

**Done means:**
- Every note below is done, or left with a reason.
- No "Customers" and no Latin text on any screen.
- "New appointment" opens a form and adds a row.
- Today shows who is running late.
- Screens no note names have not changed.
- The link opens.

**The five notes, as I read them** (full table in `loop-runs/product-design-loop-20261126-035212/requests.md`; add or correct any):
- R1 Clients page: title "Customers" becomes "Clients", matching the rest of the app.
- R2 Today: "New appointment" opens a form and adds a row.
- R3 All screens: replace the plain system font with one chosen font.
- R4 Settings: replace the Latin under "Booking policy" with real wording.
- R5 Today: add a Status column and an "N running late" line.

About 15 minutes and 2 helper agents, within a budget of 60 minutes.

1. What should "New appointment" do?
   Recommended: open a form (client, therapist, time, type, room); "Add" puts a new row in today's table. Sample only, nothing saved.
   Why it matters: the button has no behaviour today, so I would otherwise be guessing.
2. How should "running late" show on Today?
   Recommended: a Status column ("On time" or "Running late, 10 min") plus a line above the table, "2 running late". The late times are made up.
   Why it matters: this decides the table's columns and what Dr Shah sees first.
3. Which font?
   Recommended: Inter, headings and text, with the system font as backup. Needs internet on the iPad.
   Why it matters: "cheap" can mean many looks; this picks one.
4. What should the Booking policy say?
   Recommended: "Appointments can be moved or cancelled free up to 24 hours before. After that, half the fee is charged." (sample wording).
   Why it matters: it is the clinic's real policy, so tell me if it is different.

Notes sent later still join this run.

Reply with your answers, or just "go" to use the defaults.
